title: Ritual essays: the sheet, abstract, method, results and blockquote boxes and the badges become rules and mono labels on the essays' ground; paper, columns, keyline and figures stay (waits on ruling)
first: This spec waits on site-masthead:question:ritual-sheet. It is written for the recommended option flatten-sheet-keep-paper; if the operator rules keep-sheet the cut is withdrawn, if flatten-all the keyline, column rule and h2 top rules go too and the spec is revised. Do not start before the ruling.

Map: docs/brand-design-language.md '## Ritual Paper' names the three essays (Blog/small-ritual-of-reach, week-of-nonconsensual-access, witness-authoritative-networking) as a deliberate scoped variant: Georgia body, a near-black-violet ground, cobalt and amber accents, mono labels; its token table lists --ritual-paper-sheet and --ritual-paper-panel. Ruling in force: operator-no-cards-except-floats. Line numbers from 410485e inside the body[data-slug] block at 101-625; re-read by selector.

Surfaces: .ritual-paper-page (198-214: the sheet; border, radius 8px, gradient and line fill, 72px shadow, two inset hairlines; cover padding 216-218; mobile 591-595), ::before badges PREPRINT / WORKING PAPER (220-240: pill, border, 999px radius, fill), article blockquote (360-371: card with left rule, fill, shadow, and a 'quoted protocol' label whose panel background masks the border, 373-385), .ritual-paper-abstract (401-409), .ritual-paper-method-card and .ritual-paper-results-strip (416-424), .ritual-paper-page-number (523-538: pill on a gradient with glow). Not touched: .gamecult-media-card ritual variant (455-474: captioned figures, the ruled exception), article code (352-358: inline, not a box), .katex-display (483-491: tied to question code-blocks), the keyline, the column rule at 544, h2 top rules, the page footer's top rule.

Mechanism, in the variant's own colours: --ritual-paper-rule replaces the sheet's and boxes' borders as top (and where named, bottom) hairlines; badges and the page number become mono labels in their existing colours; the blockquote keeps its orange left rule only. The essays' ground (119-123) is the paper now, which is why the sheet can go: there is no seam to hide.
Pills: the PREPRINT badge and page number are mono labels inside the variant, not nav; they are flattened here, not in the pills cut (campaign map B3).

220-240 badges: padding (225), border (227), border-radius (228), background (229) deleted; in the WORKING PAPER variant border-color (238) and background (239) deleted, content and color stay.

360-371 blockquote: border (364), border-radius (366), background (367-369), box-shadow (370) deleted; border-left stays. 373-385 ::before: position, top, left, padding, background deleted (5 lines); content, color, font, size, tracking, transform stay.
401-409 abstract: border, border-radius, background (3 lines) deleted. 416-424 method card and results strip: border, border-radius, background (3 lines) deleted.
523-538 page number: min-width, padding, border, border-radius, background, box-shadow (3 lines) deleted; color becomes var(--ritual-paper-yellow).

105-108: --ritual-paper-sheet, --ritual-paper-sheet-2, --ritual-paper-panel, --ritual-paper-panel-2 deleted (no reader after this cut). docs/brand-design-language.md token table (112-125): the sheet and panel rows deleted.

keeps_moves: The essays' ground (119-123), grid, hidden left sidebar, right TOC, article width 980px and Georgia type, h1/titleblock, keyline (290-302), h2 top rules (311-317), h3, links, list markers, results-strip internal column rules (441-453), media figures (455-474), katex (483-491, pending code-blocks), page footer top rule (493-502), footnotes, the 1120px two-column rule and column-span list, the 760px single-column rules: unchanged.
The badges keep position absolute top/right on wide screens and static inline-block on phones (597-601); they are mono labels now.
adds: custom.scss .ritual-paper-page: padding: 0; margin: 0 0 2.6rem; (the sheet's inset is the column's now).
custom.scss article blockquote: padding: 0.2rem 0 0.2rem 1.35rem; article blockquote::before: display: block; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; (the label sits above the quote, nothing to mask).
custom.scss .ritual-paper-abstract: padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ritual-paper-rule); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ritual-paper-rule);

custom.scss .ritual-paper-method-card: padding: 0.8rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 178, 30, 0.42); .ritual-paper-results-strip: border-top and border-bottom 1px solid rgba(255, 178, 30, 0.42); (the amber the boxes already used, now as rules).

docs/brand-design-language.md '## Ritual Paper': the sentence naming the ground becomes: the essays sit on their own near-black-violet ground with no sheet; sections are separated by cobalt and amber rules; PREPRINT, WORKING PAPER and the page number are mono labels. Token rows for sheet and panel removed.

file_changes.change: sheet box and cover padding deleted; badges become labels.
blockquote box deleted; label above the quote.
abstract, method card and results strip: boxes become rules.
page number becomes a mono label.
mobile sheet padding and radius deleted.
Ritual Paper section: no sheet; token rows removed.

authority_map.owner: The ritual block in custom.scss owns the essays' ground and their grouping through --ritual-paper-rule and the amber rule; the brand doc describes it. The essays' markup owns the paper's sections.
inputs: --ritual-paper-rule, --ritual-paper-yellow, the amber literal the boxes already used
outputs: three essays set as a paper on their own ground: ruled abstract, method and results, a left-ruled quoted protocol, mono labels for PREPRINT, WORKING PAPER and the page number, captioned figures as the only cards
derived_state: the paper's inset is derived from the column and article width; the sheet's padding is gone
the badge and page-number marks are derived from colour and the mono face; no box carries them
forbidden_writers: no background, border-radius or box-shadow on .ritual-paper-page, the badges, article blockquote, .ritual-paper-abstract, .ritual-paper-method-card, .ritual-paper-results-strip or .ritual-paper-page-number; borders only as the named top/bottom/left rules
no change to the media figure rule, the inline code rule, katex (pending code-blocks), the keyline, the columns, the essays' markup, the pills, the masthead or the engine
shared_paths: the same policy as the rest of the site, in the variant's own colours; the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The sheet, the boxes, the badge pills and the four tokens are deleted before the rule declarations and label styles are written.

builds: Deploy Quartz green on the landing commit: gh run list -R GameCult/gamecult-site -w "Deploy Quartz" -L 1
